mapper.select: SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM document_index_task WHERE document_id=#{id} AND status IN ('PENDING','RUNNING'))
SELECT id FROM document WHERE id=#{id} AND NOT deleted FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO document_version(document_id,version_no,name,source_format,mime_type,size_bytes,sha256,object_key) SELECT document_id,#{version},name,source_format,mime_type,size_bytes,sha256,object_key FROM document_version WHERE document_id=#{id} AND version_no=#{current}
mapper.select: SELECT id,document_id,document_version,cleanup_type,status,attempt_count,next_attempt_at,error_code FROM document_cleanup_task WHERE document_id=#{id} ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 100

UPDATE document_cleanup_task SET status='RUNNING',attempt_count=attempt_count+1, next_attempt_at=clock_timestamp()+#{leaseMs}*interval '1 millisecond',error_code=NULL WHERE id=(SELECT id FROM document_cleanup_task WHERE status<>'COMPLETED' AND next_attempt_at<=clock_timestamp() ORDER BY next_attempt_at,id LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED) RETURNING id,document_id,document_version,cleanup_type,status,attempt_count,next_attempt_at,error_code
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM document_parse_result WHERE document_id=#{id} AND (#{version}=0 OR document_version=#{version})
DELETE FROM document_chunk_result WHERE document_id=#{id} AND (#{version}=0 OR document_version=#{version})
mapper.select: SELECT k.id FROM knowledge_base k JOIN document d ON d.knowledge_base_id=k.id WHERE d.id=#{id} FOR UPDATE OF k
SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM document_version v JOIN document d ON d.id=v.document_id WHERE v.object_key=#{key} AND NOT d.deleted)
